cards.card_text: Then the Levites pray, calling God's name glorious and exalted above all blessing and praise.
cards.verse_text: Then the Levites—Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah—said, “Stand up and bless the LORD your God from everlasting to everlasting: Blessed be Your glorious name, and may it be exalted above all blessing and praise.
cards.snippet: …Blessed be Your glorious name, and may it be exalted above all blessing and praise.

cards.card_text: In a loud voice they say: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”
cards.verse_text: In a loud voice they were saying: “Worthy is the Lamb who was slain, to receive power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”
cards.snippet: …power and riches and wisdom and strength and honor and glory and blessing!”

cards.card_text: Between an Amen at the start and an Amen at the end, they say blessing, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power and strength be to our God forever and ever.
cards.verse_text: Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength be to our God forever and ever!
cards.snippet: Blessing and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor and power and strength…
